name: surviver
description: Co-op TABS-style horde survival: authoritative WebSocket server + Three.js client

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @surviver/client && npm run build -w @surviver/server
scripts.build:win: npm run build:desktop -w @surviver/client && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run build:win
